exercises.title: List default organization details
exercises.prompt: Project ORG_CODE, ORG_DESC, ORG_CURR, and ORG_COMMON from R5ORGANIZATION ordered by ORG_CODE.
exercises.sql: SELECT ORG_CODE, ORG_DESC, ORG_CURR, ORG_COMMON FROM R5ORGANIZATION ORDER BY ORG_CODE;
exercises.verify: Returns the default organization row from the restored vanilla database.

exercises.title: Financials install parameters
exercises.prompt: Find all rows in R5INSTALL where INS_MODULE = 'FINANCIALS', projecting INS_CODE, INS_DESC, and INS_FIXED ordered by INS_CODE.
exercises.sql: SELECT INS_CODE, INS_DESC, INS_FIXED FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_MODULE = 'FINANCIALS' ORDER BY INS_CODE;
exercises.verify: Lists all FINANCIALS module install parameters in alphabetical order.

exercises.title: Install parameters without descriptions
exercises.prompt: Count how many R5INSTALL rows have INS_DESC IS NULL versus non-NULL, grouped by INS_FIXED, ordered by INS_FIXED.
exercises.sql: SELECT INS_FIXED, SUM(CASE WHEN INS_DESC IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_desc, SUM(CASE WHEN INS_DESC IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_desc FROM R5INSTALL GROUP BY INS_FIXED ORDER BY INS_FIXED;
exercises.verify: Shows NULL vs non-NULL INS_DESC counts split by INS_FIXED.

exercises.title: Install parameters per module
exercises.prompt: Count install parameters per INS_MODULE (using COALESCE(INS_MODULE, '(none)')) in R5INSTALL, ordered by param_count DESC, module.
exercises.sql: SELECT COALESCE(INS_MODULE, '(none)') AS module, COUNT(*) AS param_count FROM R5INSTALL GROUP BY COALESCE(INS_MODULE, '(none)') ORDER BY param_count DESC, module;
exercises.verify: Aggregates R5INSTALL by module with NULL modules labeled '(none)'.

exercises.title: Top 15 function classes in R5FUNCTIONS
exercises.prompt: Aggregate R5FUNCTIONS by FUN_CLASS, returning the top 15 classes by function count (ordered by cnt DESC, FUN_CLASS).
exercises.sql: SELECT COALESCE(FUN_CLASS, '(none)') AS fun_class, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM R5FUNCTIONS GROUP BY COALESCE(FUN_CLASS, '(none)') ORDER BY cnt DESC, fun_class LIMIT 15;
exercises.verify: Top 15 function classes in EAM 11.6 vanilla.

exercises.title: Multilingual entities in R5ENTITIES
exercises.prompt: Count entities in R5ENTITIES by ENT_MULTILANG (coalescing NULL to '(null)'), ordered by cnt DESC, multilang.
exercises.sql: SELECT COALESCE(ENT_MULTILANG, '(null)') AS multilang, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM R5ENTITIES GROUP BY COALESCE(ENT_MULTILANG, '(null)') ORDER BY cnt DESC, multilang;
exercises.verify: Breaks down all 684 R5ENTITIES rows by ENT_MULTILANG flag.

exercises.title: Entities with above-average UCode counts
exercises.prompt: Using a CTE, compute UCode counts per UCO_RENTITY in R5UCODES, then return entities whose count exceeds the average across all entities, ordered by cnt DESC, UCO_RENTITY LIMIT 25.
exercises.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT UCO_RENTITY, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM R5UCODES GROUP BY UCO_RENTITY) SELECT UCO_RENTITY, cnt FROM counts WHERE cnt > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM counts) ORDER BY cnt DESC, UCO_RENTITY LIMIT 25;
exercises.verify: Filters R5UCODES entities above the mean UCode count.

exercises.title: Join R5UCODES to R5ENTITIES
exercises.prompt: Join R5UCODES to R5ENTITIES on UCO_RENTITY = ENT_RENTITY and return the top 20 entities by UCode count, including ENT_MULTILANG, ordered by ucode_cnt DESC, ENT_RENTITY.
exercises.sql: SELECT e.ENT_RENTITY, e.ENT_MULTILANG, COUNT(u.UCO_CODE) AS ucode_cnt FROM R5ENTITIES AS e JOIN R5UCODES AS u ON u.UCO_RENTITY = e.ENT_RENTITY GROUP BY e.ENT_RENTITY, e.ENT_MULTILANG ORDER BY ucode_cnt DESC, e.ENT_RENTITY LIMIT 20;
exercises.verify: Matches R5ENTITIES to R5UCODES via ENT_RENTITY.

exercises.title: Entities with zero UCodes
exercises.prompt: Use NOT EXISTS to count how many R5ENTITIES have no matching row in R5UCODES (UCO_RENTITY = ENT_RENTITY).
exercises.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS entities_without_ucodes FROM R5ENTITIES AS e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM R5UCODES AS u WHERE u.UCO_RENTITY = e.ENT_RENTITY);
exercises.verify: Anti-join counting R5ENTITIES with no entries in R5UCODES.

exercises.title: Entities with UDF configuration
exercises.prompt: Join R5ENTITIES to R5USERDEFINEDFIELDSETUP on ENT_RENTITY = UDF_RENTITY to find the top 20 entities by configured UDF fields (in the 5,000-row capped export), ordered by udf_count DESC, ENT_RENTITY.
exercises.sql: SELECT e.ENT_RENTITY, e.ENT_MULTILANG, COUNT(u.UDF_FIELD) AS udf_count FROM R5ENTITIES AS e JOIN R5USERDEFINEDFIELDSETUP AS u ON u.UDF_RENTITY = e.ENT_RENTITY GROUP BY e.ENT_RENTITY, e.ENT_MULTILANG ORDER BY udf_count DESC, e.ENT_RENTITY LIMIT 20;
exercises.verify: Cross-family join between R5ENTITIES (r5) and R5USERDEFINEDFIELDSETUP (udf).

exercises.title: Empty R5 operational table check
exercises.prompt: Verify that R5EVENTS has 0 rows in the vanilla reference backup by returning COUNT(*) AS evt_count.
exercises.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS evt_count FROM R5EVENTS;
exercises.verify: Returns 0 because 116_van.bak is a vanilla seed database without transactional work orders.

exercises.title: Sample UDF setup definitions
exercises.prompt: Select the first 15 rows from R5USERDEFINEDFIELDSETUP projecting UDF_RENTITY, UDF_FIELD, UDF_PRINT, and UDF_LOOKUPTYPE ordered by UDF_RENTITY, UDF_FIELD.
exercises.sql: SELECT UDF_RENTITY, UDF_FIELD, UDF_PRINT, UDF_LOOKUPTYPE FROM R5USERDEFINEDFIELDSETUP ORDER BY UDF_RENTITY, UDF_FIELD LIMIT 15;
exercises.verify: Projects core columns from the UDF setup table.

exercises.title: Date-typed UDFs
exercises.prompt: Count how many exported UDFs have UDF_DATETYPE IS NOT NULL grouped by UDF_DATETYPE, ordered by cnt DESC, UDF_DATETYPE.
exercises.sql: SELECT UDF_DATETYPE, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM R5USERDEFINEDFIELDSETUP WHERE UDF_DATETYPE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY UDF_DATETYPE ORDER BY cnt DESC, UDF_DATETYPE;
exercises.verify: Groups date-type UDF definitions by UDF_DATETYPE.

exercises.title: UDF lookup validation coverage
exercises.prompt: Summarize R5USERDEFINEDFIELDSETUP by COALESCE(UDF_LOOKUPTYPE, '(none)') and COALESCE(UDF_LOOKUPVALIDATE, '(null)'), ordered by cnt DESC, lookup_type, lookup_validate.
exercises.sql: SELECT COALESCE(UDF_LOOKUPTYPE, '(none)') AS lookup_type, COALESCE(UDF_LOOKUPVALIDATE, '(null)') AS lookup_validate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM R5USERDEFINEDFIELDSETUP GROUP BY COALESCE(UDF_LOOKUPTYPE, '(none)'), COALESCE(UDF_LOOKUPVALIDATE, '(null)') ORDER BY cnt DESC, lookup_type, lookup_validate;
exercises.verify: Shows how NULL lookup types and validation flags distribute across UDFs.

exercises.title: UDF field name patterns
exercises.prompt: Group exported R5USERDEFINEDFIELDSETUP rows by UDF_FIELD (top 20 by count), ordered by cnt DESC, UDF_FIELD.
exercises.sql: SELECT UDF_FIELD, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM R5USERDEFINEDFIELDSETUP GROUP BY UDF_FIELD ORDER BY cnt DESC, UDF_FIELD LIMIT 20;
exercises.verify: Shows the most common UDF slot names (udfchar01, udfdate01, etc.).

exercises.title: UDF page dependency cache settings
exercises.prompt: Count rows in R5USERDEFINEDFIELDDEPENDENCIES by UFD_GRIDCACHE and UFD_LAYOUTCACHE, ordered by cnt DESC, UFD_GRIDCACHE, UFD_LAYOUTCACHE.
exercises.sql: SELECT UFD_GRIDCACHE, UFD_LAYOUTCACHE, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM R5USERDEFINEDFIELDDEPENDENCIES GROUP BY UFD_GRIDCACHE, UFD_LAYOUTCACHE ORDER BY cnt DESC, UFD_GRIDCACHE, UFD_LAYOUTCACHE;
exercises.verify: Aggregates all 342 UDF dependency rows by cache flags.

exercises.title: Entities with >30 UDFs in setup
exercises.prompt: Use a HAVING or subquery filter on R5USERDEFINEDFIELDSETUP to list entities with more than 30 exported UDFs, ordered by cnt DESC, UDF_RENTITY LIMIT 25.
exercises.sql: SELECT UDF_RENTITY, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM R5USERDEFINEDFIELDSETUP GROUP BY UDF_RENTITY HAVING COUNT(*) > 30 ORDER BY cnt DESC, UDF_RENTITY LIMIT 25;
exercises.verify: Returns entities with the richest UDF slot configurations.

exercises.title: Join UDF setup to UDF dependencies
exercises.prompt: Join R5USERDEFINEDFIELDDEPENDENCIES to R5USERDEFINEDFIELDSETUP on UFD_RENTITY = UDF_RENTITY to count UDF slots per dependency entity, ordered by udf_slots DESC, d.UFD_RENTITY LIMIT 20.
exercises.sql: SELECT d.UFD_RENTITY, COUNT(DISTINCT d.UFD_PAGENAME) AS pages, COUNT(DISTINCT s.UDF_FIELD) AS udf_slots FROM R5USERDEFINEDFIELDDEPENDENCIES AS d JOIN R5USERDEFINEDFIELDSETUP AS s ON s.UDF_RENTITY = d.UFD_RENTITY GROUP BY d.UFD_RENTITY ORDER BY udf_slots DESC, d.UFD_RENTITY LIMIT 20;
exercises.verify: Links UDF screen dependencies to UDF field definitions within the udf family.

exercises.title: Compare R5 vs TX UDF dependency counts
exercises.prompt: Compare row counts of R5USERDEFINEDFIELDDEPENDENCIES and TXUSERDEFINEDFIELDDEPENDENCIES in a single-row CTE query.
exercises.sql: WITH r5_cnt AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM R5USERDEFINEDFIELDDEPENDENCIES), tx_cnt AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM TXUSERDEFINEDFIELDDEPENDENCIES) SELECT r5_cnt.n AS r5_udf_deps, tx_cnt.n AS tx_udf_deps FROM r5_cnt, tx_cnt;
exercises.verify: Both tables contain 342 rows in the vanilla backup.

exercises.title: UDF dependencies resolved to R5FUNCTIONS
exercises.prompt: Join R5USERDEFINEDFIELDDEPENDENCIES (udf) to R5FUNCTIONS (r5) on UFD_PAGENAME = FUN_CODE to show page descriptions for the first 20 dependencies ordered by UFD_RENTITY, UFD_PAGENAME.
exercises.sql: SELECT d.UFD_RENTITY, d.UFD_PAGENAME, f.FUN_DESC, f.FUN_CLASS FROM R5USERDEFINEDFIELDDEPENDENCIES AS d LEFT JOIN R5FUNCTIONS AS f ON f.FUN_CODE = d.UFD_PAGENAME ORDER BY d.UFD_RENTITY, d.UFD_PAGENAME LIMIT 20;
exercises.verify: Cross-family join resolving UDF page names against R5FUNCTIONS.

exercises.title: UDF dependencies verified against R5ENTITIES
exercises.prompt: Join R5USERDEFINEDFIELDDEPENDENCIES (udf) to R5ENTITIES (r5) on UFD_RENTITY = ENT_RENTITY and count dependency pages per entity (top 20 by pages DESC, UFD_RENTITY).
exercises.sql: SELECT d.UFD_RENTITY, e.ENT_MULTILANG, COUNT(*) AS page_count FROM R5USERDEFINEDFIELDDEPENDENCIES AS d JOIN R5ENTITIES AS e ON e.ENT_RENTITY = d.UFD_RENTITY GROUP BY d.UFD_RENTITY, e.ENT_MULTILANG ORDER BY page_count DESC, d.UFD_RENTITY LIMIT 20;
exercises.verify: Verifies UDF dependency entities against R5ENTITIES.

exercises.title: Check custom screens and LOVs
exercises.prompt: Check row counts of R5UDFSCREENS and R5USERDEFINEDFIELDLOVVALS in one query to confirm neither has seed rows in vanilla.
exercises.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5UDFSCREENS) AS udf_screens, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5USERDEFINEDFIELDLOVVALS) AS udf_lov_vals;
exercises.verify: Both return 0 in 116_van.bak.

exercises.title: Sample TXFUNCTIONS rows
exercises.prompt: Project FUN_CODE, FUN_DESC, and FUN_CLASS for the first 15 rows in TXFUNCTIONS ordered by FUN_CODE.
exercises.sql: SELECT FUN_CODE, FUN_DESC, FUN_CLASS FROM TXFUNCTIONS ORDER BY FUN_CODE LIMIT 15;
exercises.verify: Lists the first 15 translated function definitions.

exercises.title: English classes in TXCLASSES
exercises.prompt: Count rows in TXCLASSES where TXC_LANG = 'EN', grouped by TXC_RENTITY (top 15 by cnt DESC, TXC_RENTITY).
exercises.sql: SELECT TXC_RENTITY, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TXCLASSES WHERE TXC_LANG = 'EN' GROUP BY TXC_RENTITY ORDER BY cnt DESC, TXC_RENTITY LIMIT 15;
exercises.verify: Counts English class definitions by entity in TXCLASSES.

exercises.title: NULL ENT_ENTITY in TXENTITIES
exercises.prompt: Count how many TXENTITIES rows have ENT_ENTITY IS NULL vs NOT NULL.
exercises.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ENT_ENTITY IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_entity, SUM(CASE WHEN ENT_ENTITY IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_null_entity FROM TXENTITIES;
exercises.verify: Checks NULL ENT_ENTITY values in TXENTITIES.

exercises.title: Languages in TXUCODES
exercises.prompt: Aggregate exported TXUCODES rows by TXU_LANG, ordered by cnt DESC, TXU_LANG.
exercises.sql: SELECT TXU_LANG, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TXUCODES GROUP BY TXU_LANG ORDER BY cnt DESC, TXU_LANG;
exercises.verify: Shows language distribution in the exported TXUCODES slice.

exercises.title: Languages in TXCLASSES
exercises.prompt: Aggregate TXCLASSES by TXC_LANG, ordered by cnt DESC, TXC_LANG.
exercises.sql: SELECT TXC_LANG, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TXCLASSES GROUP BY TXC_LANG ORDER BY cnt DESC, TXC_LANG;
exercises.verify: Shows all language codes present in TXCLASSES.

exercises.title: TXFUNCTIONS classes above average size
exercises.prompt: Use a CTE to count TXFUNCTIONS per FUN_CLASS and return classes with more functions than the class average, ordered by cnt DESC, fun_class.
exercises.sql: WITH cls AS (SELECT COALESCE(FUN_CLASS, '(none)') AS fun_class, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TXFUNCTIONS GROUP BY COALESCE(FUN_CLASS, '(none)')) SELECT fun_class, cnt FROM cls WHERE cnt > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM cls) ORDER BY cnt DESC, fun_class;
exercises.verify: Filters TXFUNCTIONS classes above the mean.

exercises.title: Join TXCLASSES to TXENTITIES
exercises.prompt: Join TXCLASSES to TXENTITIES on TXC_RENTITY = ENT_RENTITY for TXC_LANG = 'EN' and return top 15 entities by class count, ordered by cls_cnt DESC, e.ENT_RENTITY.
exercises.sql: SELECT e.ENT_RENTITY, e.ENT_MULTILANG, COUNT(c.TXC_CODE) AS cls_cnt FROM TXENTITIES AS e JOIN TXCLASSES AS c ON c.TXC_RENTITY = e.ENT_RENTITY WHERE c.TXC_LANG = 'EN' GROUP BY e.ENT_RENTITY, e.ENT_MULTILANG ORDER BY cls_cnt DESC, e.ENT_RENTITY LIMIT 15;
exercises.verify: Joins TXCLASSES to TXENTITIES within the tx family.

exercises.title: TXDDFIELD data types
exercises.prompt: Aggregate exported TXDDFIELD rows by DDF_DATATYPE, ordered by cnt DESC, DDF_DATATYPE.
exercises.sql: SELECT COALESCE(DDF_DATATYPE, '(null)') AS datatype, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TXDDFIELD GROUP BY COALESCE(DDF_DATATYPE, '(null)') ORDER BY cnt DESC, datatype;
exercises.verify: Shows data types in the exported TXDDFIELD data dictionary slice.

exercises.title: Compare TXFUNCTIONS vs R5FUNCTIONS
exercises.prompt: Left-join R5FUNCTIONS to TXFUNCTIONS on FUN_CODE to count how many R5 functions exist in TXFUNCTIONS vs missing from TXFUNCTIONS.
exercises.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.FUN_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matched_in_tx, SUM(CASE WHEN t.FUN_CODE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS only_in_r5 FROM R5FUNCTIONS AS r LEFT JOIN TXFUNCTIONS AS t ON t.FUN_CODE = r.FUN_CODE;
exercises.verify: Cross-family comparison between R5FUNCTIONS (r5) and TXFUNCTIONS (tx).

exercises.title: TXENTITIES with UDF setup
exercises.prompt: Join TXENTITIES (tx) to R5USERDEFINEDFIELDSETUP (udf) on ENT_RENTITY = UDF_RENTITY and return the top 15 entities by UDF count, ordered by udf_cnt DESC, e.ENT_RENTITY.
exercises.sql: SELECT e.ENT_RENTITY, COUNT(u.UDF_FIELD) AS udf_cnt FROM TXENTITIES AS e JOIN R5USERDEFINEDFIELDSETUP AS u ON u.UDF_RENTITY = e.ENT_RENTITY GROUP BY e.ENT_RENTITY ORDER BY udf_cnt DESC, e.ENT_RENTITY LIMIT 15;
exercises.verify: Cross-family join between TXENTITIES (tx) and R5USERDEFINEDFIELDSETUP (udf).

exercises.title: Sample Unicode text in TXALLTXTS
exercises.prompt: Select the first 10 rows of TXALLTXTS projecting ATX_CODE, ATX_TEXTTYPE, ATX_LANG, and ATX_TEXT ordered by ATX_CODE, ATX_TEXTTYPE, ATX_LANG.
exercises.sql: SELECT ATX_CODE, ATX_TEXTTYPE, ATX_LANG, ATX_TEXT FROM TXALLTXTS ORDER BY ATX_CODE, ATX_TEXTTYPE, ATX_LANG LIMIT 10;
exercises.verify: Verifies Unicode text preservation in TXALLTXTS.

exercises.title: List all 17 Data Lake tables
exercises.prompt: Project TABLEID, NAME, CLIENTNAME, and SCHEDULEID from DATALAKE_TABLE ordered by TABLEID.
exercises.sql: SELECT TABLEID, NAME, CLIENTNAME, SCHEDULEID FROM DATALAKE_TABLE ORDER BY TABLEID;
exercises.verify: Returns all 17 tables configured for Infor Data Lake ingestion.

exercises.title: Filter Data Lake columns by data type
exercises.prompt: Find all columns in DATALAKE_COLUMN where DATATYPE = 'datetime' or 'date', projecting TABLEID, NAME, and DATATYPE ordered by TABLEID, NAME LIMIT 25.
exercises.sql: SELECT TABLEID, NAME, DATATYPE FROM DATALAKE_COLUMN WHERE LOWER(DATATYPE) IN ('datetime', 'date') ORDER BY TABLEID, NAME LIMIT 25;
exercises.verify: Lists date/datetime columns in the Data Lake catalog.

exercises.title: Data Lake schedule last-run status
exercises.prompt: Inspect DATALAKE_SCHEDULE projecting SCHEDULEID, NAME, FREQUENCY, STATUS, and COALESCE(LASTRUNAT, 'Never run') AS last_run.
exercises.sql: SELECT SCHEDULEID, NAME, FREQUENCY, STATUS, COALESCE(LASTRUNAT, 'Never run') AS last_run FROM DATALAKE_SCHEDULE ORDER BY SCHEDULEID;
exercises.verify: Shows the Data Lake schedule with NULL LASTRUNAT handled cleanly.

exercises.title: Column data type distribution
exercises.prompt: Count Data Lake columns by DATATYPE in DATALAKE_COLUMN, ordered by cnt DESC, DATATYPE.
exercises.sql: SELECT DATATYPE, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM DATALAKE_COLUMN GROUP BY DATATYPE ORDER BY cnt DESC, DATATYPE;
exercises.verify: Aggregates all 249 DATALAKE_COLUMN rows by SQL data type.

exercises.title: Columns per Data Lake table
exercises.prompt: Join DATALAKE_TABLE to DATALAKE_COLUMN on TABLEID and count columns per table, ordered by col_cnt DESC, t.NAME.
exercises.sql: SELECT t.TABLEID, t.NAME, COUNT(c.COLUMNID) AS col_cnt FROM DATALAKE_TABLE AS t LEFT JOIN DATALAKE_COLUMN AS c ON c.TABLEID = t.TABLEID GROUP BY t.TABLEID, t.NAME ORDER BY col_cnt DESC, t.NAME;
exercises.verify: Shows column counts for each of the 17 Data Lake tables.

exercises.title: Data Lake schema upload timestamps
exercises.prompt: Join DATALAKE_TABLE to DATALAKE_SCHEMAUPLOAD on TABLEID to show each table's NAME and UPDATEDON, ordered by t.TABLEID.
exercises.sql: SELECT t.TABLEID, t.NAME, s.UPDATEDON FROM DATALAKE_TABLE AS t LEFT JOIN DATALAKE_SCHEMAUPLOAD AS s ON s.TABLEID = t.TABLEID ORDER BY t.TABLEID;
exercises.verify: Matches each Data Lake table to its schema upload record.

exercises.title: Map Data Lake columns to JSON catalog types
exercises.prompt: Join DATALAKE_COLUMN to DATALAKE_TYPECONVERSION on LOWER(c.DATATYPE) = LOWER(tc.DATATYPE) and count columns per CATALOGTYPE, ordered by col_cnt DESC, catalog_type.
exercises.sql: SELECT COALESCE(tc.CATALOGTYPE, '(unmapped)') AS catalog_type, COUNT(*) AS col_cnt FROM DATALAKE_COLUMN AS c LEFT JOIN DATALAKE_TYPECONVERSION AS tc ON LOWER(c.DATATYPE) = LOWER(tc.DATATYPE) GROUP BY COALESCE(tc.CATALOGTYPE, '(unmapped)') ORDER BY col_cnt DESC, catalog_type;
exercises.verify: Maps SQL Server types in DATALAKE_COLUMN to Data Lake catalog types.

exercises.title: Data Lake tables above average column count
exercises.prompt: Use a CTE to compute column counts per Data Lake table and return tables above the average, ordered by col_cnt DESC, NAME.
exercises.sql: WITH tc AS (SELECT t.NAME, COUNT(c.COLUMNID) AS col_cnt FROM DATALAKE_TABLE AS t JOIN DATALAKE_COLUMN AS c ON c.TABLEID = t.TABLEID GROUP BY t.NAME) SELECT NAME, col_cnt FROM tc WHERE col_cnt > (SELECT AVG(col_cnt) FROM tc) ORDER BY col_cnt DESC, NAME;
exercises.verify: Returns Data Lake tables with above-average column counts.

exercises.title: Data Lake tables vs TABLECOUNT_MSSQL
exercises.prompt: Left-join DATALAKE_TABLE (datalake) to TABLECOUNT_MSSQL (other) on UPPER(t.NAME) = UPPER(m.TABLE_NAME) to inspect source row counts for Data Lake tables, ordered by t.TABLEID.
exercises.sql: SELECT t.TABLEID, t.NAME, m.TABLE_COUNT FROM DATALAKE_TABLE AS t LEFT JOIN TABLECOUNT_MSSQL AS m ON UPPER(t.NAME) = UPPER(m.TABLE_NAME) ORDER BY t.TABLEID;
exercises.verify: Cross-family join between DATALAKE_TABLE (datalake) and TABLECOUNT_MSSQL (other).

exercises.title: Compare Data Lake max IDs to sequence tables
exercises.prompt: Compare MAX(TABLEID) in DATALAKE_TABLE and MAX(COLUMNID) in DATALAKE_COLUMN against MAX(SEQ_NEXTVALUE) in SEQ_S5DATALAKE_TABLE and SEQ_S5DATALAKE_COLUMN.
exercises.sql: SELECT (SELECT MAX(TABLEID) FROM DATALAKE_TABLE) AS max_table_id, (SELECT MAX(SEQ_NEXTVALUE) FROM SEQ_S5DATALAKE_TABLE) AS seq_table_max, (SELECT MAX(COLUMNID) FROM DATALAKE_COLUMN) AS max_col_id, (SELECT MAX(SEQ_NEXTVALUE) FROM SEQ_S5DATALAKE_COLUMN) AS seq_col_max;
exercises.verify: Verifies sequence parity between Data Lake tables and their SEQ_S5* sequences.

exercises.title: Match Data Lake tables to R5USERTABCOLUMNS
exercises.prompt: Join DATALAKE_TABLE (datalake) to R5USERTABCOLUMNS (r5) on UPPER(t.NAME) = UPPER(u.UTC_TABLENAME) to count matching R5 catalog columns per Data Lake table, ordered by t.NAME.
exercises.sql: SELECT t.NAME, COUNT(u.UTC_COLUMNNAME) AS r5_catalog_cols FROM DATALAKE_TABLE AS t LEFT JOIN R5USERTABCOLUMNS AS u ON UPPER(t.NAME) = UPPER(u.UTC_TABLENAME) GROUP BY t.NAME ORDER BY t.NAME;
exercises.verify: Cross-family join matching DATALAKE_TABLE against the exported R5USERTABCOLUMNS slice.

exercises.title: Query Oracle-style DUAL table
exercises.prompt: Select dummy from DUAL.
exercises.sql: SELECT dummy FROM DUAL;
exercises.verify: Returns the single row ('X') from DUAL.

exercises.title: Non-empty tables in TABLECOUNT_MSSQL
exercises.prompt: Find the top 20 largest tables recorded in TABLECOUNT_MSSQL (TABLE_COUNT > 0), ordered by TABLE_COUNT DESC, TABLE_NAME.
exercises.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, TABLE_COUNT FROM TABLECOUNT_MSSQL WHERE TABLE_COUNT > 0 ORDER BY TABLE_COUNT DESC, TABLE_NAME LIMIT 20;
exercises.verify: Lists the top 20 populated tables from the TABLECOUNT_MSSQL inventory table.

exercises.title: Empty vs populated tables in TABLECOUNT_MSSQL
exercises.prompt: Count how many tables in TABLECOUNT_MSSQL have TABLE_COUNT = 0 vs TABLE_COUNT > 0, and sum TABLE_COUNT.
exercises.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN TABLE_COUNT = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_row_tables, SUM(CASE WHEN TABLE_COUNT > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS populated_tables, SUM(TABLE_COUNT) AS total_recorded_rows FROM TABLECOUNT_MSSQL;
exercises.verify: Summarizes the 1,248 tables tracked in TABLECOUNT_MSSQL.

exercises.title: Inspect special-character table V$SESSION
exercises.prompt: Query "V$SESSION" (requires double-quoting because of '$') and return COUNT(*) AS session_rows.
exercises.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS session_rows FROM "V$SESSION";
exercises.verify: Tests identifier quoting for V$SESSION (0 rows in vanilla).

exercises.title: Sequence high-water marks
exercises.prompt: Compare MAX(SEQ_NEXTVALUE) and row count across four populated SEQ_S5* sequence tables using UNION ALL.
exercises.sql: SELECT 'SEQ_S5CODESTRUCTURE' AS seq_table, COUNT(*) AS rows, MAX(SEQ_NEXTVALUE) AS max_val FROM SEQ_S5CODESTRUCTURE UNION ALL SELECT 'SEQ_S5HYPERLINK', COUNT(*), MAX(SEQ_NEXTVALUE) FROM SEQ_S5HYPERLINK UNION ALL SELECT 'SEQ_S5ACCOUNTDETAIL', COUNT(*), MAX(SEQ_NEXTVALUE) FROM SEQ_S5ACCOUNTDETAIL UNION ALL SELECT 'SEQ_S5SESSIONS', COUNT(*), MAX(SEQ_NEXTVALUE) FROM SEQ_S5SESSIONS ORDER BY max_val DESC;
exercises.verify: Compares sequence high-water marks across populated SEQ_S5* tables.

exercises.title: Tables in TABLECOUNT_MSSQL above 10,000 rows
exercises.prompt: Use a CTE on TABLECOUNT_MSSQL to list all tables with TABLE_COUNT >= 10000, ordered by TABLE_COUNT DESC, TABLE_NAME.
exercises.sql: WITH big AS (SELECT TABLE_NAME, TABLE_COUNT FROM TABLECOUNT_MSSQL WHERE TABLE_COUNT >= 10000) SELECT TABLE_NAME, TABLE_COUNT FROM big ORDER BY TABLE_COUNT DESC, TABLE_NAME;
exercises.verify: Lists all R5 tables recorded with >= 10,000 rows in TABLECOUNT_MSSQL.

exercises.title: Row-count buckets in TABLECOUNT_MSSQL
exercises.prompt: Bucket all 1,248 tables in TABLECOUNT_MSSQL into '0', '1-99', '100-999', '1000-4999', '5000+' and count tables per bucket.
exercises.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN TABLE_COUNT = 0 THEN '0' WHEN TABLE_COUNT < 100 THEN '1-99' WHEN TABLE_COUNT < 1000 THEN '100-999' WHEN TABLE_COUNT < 5000 THEN '1000-4999' ELSE '5000+' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS table_cnt FROM TABLECOUNT_MSSQL GROUP BY CASE WHEN TABLE_COUNT = 0 THEN '0' WHEN TABLE_COUNT < 100 THEN '1-99' WHEN TABLE_COUNT < 1000 THEN '100-999' WHEN TABLE_COUNT < 5000 THEN '1000-4999' ELSE '5000+' END ORDER BY MIN(TABLE_COUNT);
exercises.verify: Buckets all 1,248 tables in TABLECOUNT_MSSQL by row count tier.

exercises.title: Check UDF tables in TABLECOUNT_MSSQL
exercises.prompt: Filter TABLECOUNT_MSSQL for UDF-related R5 tables (R5USERDEFINED% or R5UDF%), ordered by TABLE_COUNT DESC, TABLE_NAME.
exercises.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, TABLE_COUNT FROM TABLECOUNT_MSSQL WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE 'R5USERDEFINED%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE 'R5UDF%' ORDER BY TABLE_COUNT DESC, TABLE_NAME;
exercises.verify: Shows TABLECOUNT_MSSQL counts for R5-prefixed UDF tables.

exercises.title: Join TABLECOUNT_MSSQL to R5USERTABCOLUMNS
exercises.prompt: Join TABLECOUNT_MSSQL (other) to R5USERTABCOLUMNS (r5) on TABLE_NAME = UTC_TABLENAME for tables with >0 exported columns, returning top 20 by TABLE_COUNT DESC, TABLE_NAME.
exercises.sql: SELECT m.TABLE_NAME, m.TABLE_COUNT, COUNT(u.UTC_COLUMNNAME) AS exported_cols FROM TABLECOUNT_MSSQL AS m JOIN R5USERTABCOLUMNS AS u ON u.UTC_TABLENAME = m.TABLE_NAME GROUP BY m.TABLE_NAME, m.TABLE_COUNT ORDER BY m.TABLE_COUNT DESC, m.TABLE_NAME LIMIT 20;
exercises.verify: Cross-family join between TABLECOUNT_MSSQL (other) and R5USERTABCOLUMNS (r5).

exercises.title: Check R5TABLES/R5FLEXTABLES in TABLECOUNT_MSSQL
exercises.prompt: Join R5FLEXTABLES (r5) to TABLECOUNT_MSSQL (other) on FLT_TABLE = TABLE_NAME to see recorded row counts for Flex-enabled tables.
exercises.sql: SELECT f.FLT_TABLE, m.TABLE_COUNT FROM R5FLEXTABLES AS f LEFT JOIN TABLECOUNT_MSSQL AS m ON m.TABLE_NAME = f.FLT_TABLE ORDER BY f.FLT_TABLE;
exercises.verify: Cross-family join between R5FLEXTABLES (r5) and TABLECOUNT_MSSQL (other).

exercises.title: Confirm ESB and O7 staging tables are empty
exercises.prompt: Verify that ESB_INBOUND_DUPLICATE, O7GLPROCESS_TBL, and TICKETS all have 0 rows in the restored vanilla database.
exercises.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ESB_INBOUND_DUPLICATE) AS esb_dup, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM O7GLPROCESS_TBL) AS o7_gl, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TICKETS) AS tickets;
exercises.verify: All three return 0 in 116_van.bak.
